title: 领益智造董事长：人形机器人已锁定30家客户，北美巨头在列
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: And then also with this year, the new affordable things is going to come. And then we focus on that.
segments.zh: 今年还有新的平价产品推出，我们聚焦于此。

segments.en: We have a lot of new technology for the new phone.
segments.zh: 我们有很多新手机技术。

segments.en: And then we believe that can help us to digest our capacity.
segments.zh: 相信这能帮助我们消化产能。

segments.en: So it would not treat the industry too much, you guys.
segments.zh: 所以不会对行业造成太大影响。

segments.en: You have opened up this new super factory in Beijing, you're targeting, you know, from 10,000 units this year to 500,000 in 2030.
segments.zh: 你在北京开了新超级工厂，目标从今年1万台到2030年50万台。

segments.en: What is underpinning this confidence and have you locked in, you know, clients for the humanoid robot?
segments.zh: 信心何来？人形机器人客户是否已锁定？

segments.en: We are locked at least 30 different clients, all the famous ones in China and also the famous one in North America.
segments.zh: 我们已锁定至少30家客户，包括中国和北美的知名企业。

segments.en: Could you share specifically which are your clients in North America?
segments.zh: 能具体分享北美客户吗？

segments.en: I'm sorry. Every big name, you can name.
segments.zh: 抱歉，每个大牌，你都能想到。

segments.en: So every big name, then they're all involved.
And then even some of the name, you don't know.
segments.zh: 甚至有些名字你不知道。

segments.en: And then we are doing the first prototype situation.
